# Merge PDFs

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pdf-merge/

Combine multiple PDF documents into one file. Reorder the selected documents before creating the combined PDF.

## How to use it

1. Choose the PDF documents or images from your device.
2. Arrange files or enter the pages and layout options.
3. Create the document and download the finished PDF.

## Example

Merge a two-page application with a three-page attachment to create a five-page document.

## Limits and checks

Password-protected files are not supported. The tool copies pages; it is not an editor for the text inside each page.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
